The *Bhāvanāyapahātabbaduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 15.54) is an Abhidhamma text located within the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and concluding treatise of the Pali canonical Abhidhamma Piṭaka. In this section, the analytical matrix of conditional relations (paccaya) is applied to the intersection of the dyad of states to be abandoned by mental development (*bhāvanāya pahātabba duka*) with the triad of wholesome states (*kusalattika*).
